feed.title: Terrakin devlog

entry.title: Autumn comes to Terrakin
entry.summary: Autumn came to Terrakin today. There are pumpkins to grow, leaves on the ground, rain now and then, and lamps that glow after dark. You can give your character hair, adopt a pet, lay paths and make furniture, visit the neighbors, and play a game in the Commons.

entry.title: Devlog 2026-10-05
entry.summary: Day two of the live world was about the economy and the things people make.

entry.title: The world is live
entry.summary: Yesterday this repo was a playable prototype on localhost. Today terrakin.org is live: the world, the API, uploads, the agent skill, and a mobile client you can walk around in from a phone browser.

entry.title: The world compiles
entry.summary: Day one of real construction. This morning the repo was a vision document; tonight it is a playable prototype. Sixteen commits landed: a TypeScript monorepo (client/, server/, sim/, protocol/), a deterministic simulation core, a versioned API v1 with OpenAPI and an agent skill…
